name: ArcGIS Pro (Esri)
notes: Dominant in US agencies; AI assistants now being embedded (EPA 'AI Assistants in Esri Tools' pilot; USDA GIS help-desk chatbot). Skills tied to UI versions decay fast; concepts do not.

name: QGIS
notes: Open-source; EMDS runs in both ArcGIS and QGIS (DC-001). Vendor-neutral training option for NGO/Tribal/local users.

name: GDAL/OGR and PROJ geospatial libraries
notes: Infrastructure under most GIS and EO stacks; slow-changing (expert judgment).

name: Cloud-native geospatial formats and catalogs (COG, Zarr, GeoParquet, STAC)
notes: Planetary Computer exposes STAC APIs (DC-027). Formats are long-lived; specific APIs less so.

name: Google Earth Engine
notes: Platform terms change: AlphaEarth embedding GCS bucket became 'provider pays' as of July 2026 (DC-028). Competencies must not assume free access.

name: Microsoft Planetary Computer
notes: Public issues repository last updated 2024-11 (DC-027); current hosted-service status not verified this session. Platform-concentration example.

name: Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 (HLS) 30 m
notes: Training data for Prithvi-EO-2.0 (DC-023); depends on continuity of Landsat and Sentinel missions.

name: National Land Cover Database (NLCD, deep-learning production)
notes: Deployed DL product (DC-001); also a training target for AlphaEarth (DC-028) - circularity risk if embeddings are used to update NLCD-like maps.

name: Prithvi-EO-2.0 (IBM-NASA) 300M/600M
notes: Released 2024-12; benchmarked on GEO-Bench; fine-tuned via TerraTorch (DC-023).

name: OlmoEarth v1/v1.1/v1.2 (Ai2) and OlmoEarth platform
notes: Three model generations in about a year (DC-025): direct evidence for a ~1-year half-life of specific models.

name: Clay foundation model
notes: Apache-2.0 code and weights (DC-024).

name: AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embedding V1 (annual, 64-D, 10 m)
notes: Dataset v1.1 (2025-11-17); model v2.1; bands 'not independently interpretable'; Google commits one year notice of delivery changes, subject to USGS/ESA data streams (DC-028).

name: TerraTorch fine-tuning toolkit
notes: IBM library used for Prithvi fine-tuning (DC-023, DC-026).

name: GEO-Bench
notes: Used to benchmark EO foundation models (DC-023). Benchmarks age as models saturate them.

name: Esri Survey123 / Field Maps
notes: Named in v1 2.3.4 task text - should move here.

name: iNaturalist
notes: Named in v1 2.3.4; community data quality and sensitive-location obscuring are durable concerns (DC-CAND-07).

name: GNSS receivers incl. RTK correction
notes: Device operation is tool fluency; accuracy concepts are durable.

name: Small UAS platforms and structure-from-motion photogrammetry software
notes: Hardware and software turn over quickly; airspace rules are policy-layer.

name: MegaDetector
notes: Detects animals, not species; adopters include Michigan DNR and TNC California (DC-038).

name: SpeciesNet (Google cameratrapai)
notes: Species classifier paired with MegaDetector (DC-038, DC-039).

name: BirdNET-Analyzer
notes: 6,512 species; built-in train/evaluate commands; per-model licences (DC-040).

name: VIAME (Video and Image Analytics for the Marine Environment)
notes: NOAA toolkit used for reef-fish and other automated identification (DC-001).

name: R ecosystem (tidyverse, sf, terra)
notes: Data Carpentry ecology lesson stable since 2015 (DC-030); its geospatial R lesson retired 2026 (DC-031) - curricula tied to package stacks churn even when the language persists.

name: Python scientific and geospatial stack (NumPy, pandas, xarray, rasterio, GeoPandas)
notes: Default for EO foundation-model work (DC-023, DC-025).

name: Jupyter notebooks
notes: Used by Prithvi and Clay examples (DC-023, DC-024).

name: Git and hosted repositories (GitHub/GitLab)
notes: Provenance backbone of OpenLMP and EMST v2.

name: Environment managers and containers (uv, conda/mamba, Docker)
notes: Tool choice shifts every few years (OlmoEarth uses uv; Clay uses mamba).

name: Relational databases and SQL (e.g., PostgreSQL/PostGIS)
notes: Longest half-life in the layer.

name: Geospatial metadata standards (ISO 19115 family; FGDC CSDGM legacy)
notes: Named in v1 2.2.5 knowledge statement; authoring increasingly AI-generated (USDA DS Hub pilot, DC-001).

name: Generative AI assistants (enterprise ChatGPT/Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude and others)
notes: USGS Azure OpenAI, NOAA Gemini, EPA Azure OpenAI in inventory (DC-001); procurement subject to M-26-04 (DC-008). Never name in competency text.

name: AI coding assistants and coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Gemini Code Assist, Amazon Q Developer, Codex CLI, Claude Code and others)
notes: Copilot, Gemini Code Assist, Amazon Q Developer pilots at NOAA/DOI (DC-001); coding agents benchmarked on DraftNEPABench (DC-032).

name: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG, GraphRAG) over agency corpora
notes: BLM AIM chatbot, BLM GraphRAG comment analysis, FVS helpdesk RAG, NOAA knowledge-graph chatbot (DC-001).

name: Public-comment analysis services (FWS DocketScope; PermitAI CommentNEPA; commercial tools)
notes: DocketScope deployed 2025-08 with analyst verification; DOI PCAT retired between 2024 and 2025 inventories (DC-001).

name: PermitAI shared services (SearchNEPA, WriteNEPA, EngageNEPA, CommentNEPA) and NEPATEC corpus
notes: DOE/PNNL platform; partners reported to include USDA and DOI (DC-033).

name: USFS planning GenAI tools (Turbo plan; Forest Plan review and planning support)
notes: Deployed June-July 2025; vendors Wildfire.org and Google (DC-001).

name: DraftNEPABench and MAPLE evaluation pipelines
notes: SME rubrics graded by LLM judges - judges themselves need human validation (DC-032).

name: NIST Dioptra
notes: Release 1.2.2; second-party testing during acquisition (DC-041).

name: Model cards, system cards and data cards
notes: Required for procured LLMs under M-26-04 (DC-008); format will evolve, the reading skill will not.

name: Ecosystem Management Decision Support (EMDS)
notes: USFS-deployed since 1997 (DC-001) - long-lived DSS show that 'AI' labels are applied retroactively to classical systems.

name: Forest Vegetation Simulator (FVS)
notes: Now wrapped by a RAG helpdesk pilot (DC-001).

name: Ecosystem-service models (InVEST, ARIES)
notes: Named in v1 6.3.2 task text - should move here.

name: Environmental-justice screening tools (EJScreen, CalEnviroScreen)
notes: Named in v1 6.7.2; federal tool availability volatile (EJScreen removal in early 2025 per expert recollection - to verify).

name: AI weather/climate emulators and AI forecast models (NOAA AI-driven global forecast model and ensemble; Ai2 Climate Emulator ACE)
notes: NOAA inventory entries (DC-001).

name: Earth-system digital twin programs (NASA ESDT; EU Destination Earth)
notes: Status not verified this session (DC-054, DC-055).

name: AR/VR headsets and immersive engines
notes: Only one AR use case (food safety, pre-deployment) among 438 USDA/DOI/EPA entries (DC-001). Watch only.

name: Blockchain/crypto and DeFi tooling for conservation finance
notes: Zero blockchain use cases among 438 USDA/DOI/EPA entries (DC-001). Watch; retire v1 3.4.3.

name: OMB M-25-21 and M-25-22 (federal AI use and acquisition)
notes: Replaced M-24-10/M-24-18 in 2025 (DC-007). Policy instruments are fast-layer content: competencies cite the function (e.g., 'risk tiering'), the layer cites the memo.

name: OMB M-26-04 Unbiased AI Principles (LLM procurement)
notes: Sunsets two years after 2025-12-11 unless extended (DC-008).

name: NIST AI RMF 1.0 and Generative AI Profile (NIST-AI-600-1)
notes: Revision under way per AI Action Plan; critical-infrastructure profile concept note 2026-04-07 (DC-004). Trustworthiness characteristics are durable vocabulary; version-specific playbook steps are not.

name: EU AI Act Article 4 AI-literacy measures (as amended by the 2026 Digital Omnibus)
notes: In force as amended 2026-07-27 (DC-017).

name: DOL AI Literacy Framework (TEN 07-25)
notes: Voluntary guidance for the public workforce system (DC-015).

name: CEQ NEPA and Permitting Data and Technology Standard (v1.2)
notes: v1.2 adds record-origin and record-version fields (DC-034); adoption required by the 2025 Permitting Technology Action Plan (DC-033).

notes: Certifiable; private-sector analog to NIST AI RMF (DC-053, not read).
